stochRsi.note: Longs only. Skip new entry if StochRSI %K >=80 unless reclaiming VWAP with rising volume. On re-hit after pullback prefer %K turned up from <=40.

vwap.note: Prefer price >= VWAP (uptrend side). Skip if price fading >1% below VWAP on falling volume.

bollinger.note: Prefer entry near mid-band or after bounce off lower with StochRSI turning up. Skip chase if last above upper AND StochRSI >=80.

fibonacci.note: Apple Fibonacci thinking. Prefer re-hit/recycle when price pulls back into 38.2-61.8% then resumes up (bid holding above fib + VWAP or mid-BB). Skip re-hit if breaks below 61.8% on rising sell volume (failed trend).

US intraday volume is U-shaped: per-5m volume midday is roughly 1/3 of the first 30 min and recovers into the close, so the floor scales with time of day: 150k (09:30-10:30) / 100k (10:30-11:30) / 50k minimum (11:30-14:00) / 75k (14:00-15:00) / 100k (15:00-15:45); fractional dollar floor scaled the same ($1.5M/$1.0M/$0.5M/$0.75M/$1.0M). ta.py applies the band (output liqFloor). sizingRule.text: If a share's price is ≤ available cash (the bank), buy WHOLE shares only, even when the stock is fractional-eligible. If the price is > available cash, the name qualifies ONLY if Robinhood marks it fractional-eligible, and then it's a fractional/dollar-amount buy; otherwise skip it.
sizingRule.availableCash: broker cash / buying power read in the same run (= bankUsd when flat)
sizingRule.wholeShareQty: allocation = availableCash / freeSlots (freeSlots = maxPositions - open positions - open buy orders, min 1); qty = floor(allocation / ask); if 0 and ask <= availableCash -> 1; then cut qty until qty x buyLimit <= availableCash x 0.99. Never fractional in that lane.
